verdict.rationale: Jules' docs state that after a task is submitted it generates a plan, which you can review and approve before any code changes are made. The API also supports explicit plan approval for sessions that require it, so plan approval works in the web app and programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the plan-review workflow, and detail on editing or rejecting plans.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review and approve an agent's implementation plan before any code changes are made
